notes.title: [THE GHOST STATION] – September 11 Update Preview
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is your guide from Purgatory.[/p][p]In this update preview, we’d like to share details about the new map [b]\[THE GHOST STATION][/b] and the beings that await you there.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Map: \[THE GHOST STATION][/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/8258e9545ec67adbd82132a1d4187d00cae35579.png"][/img][/p][p]At the end of your endless journey of atonement, the gates of the hidden [b]Ghost Station[/b] deep within Purgatory have opened.
Of course, it comes with a [b]one-way ticket[/b] just for you.[/p][p]This is the final stop: [b]The Ghost Station.[/b]
The doors… will not open.[/p][p]This station is divided into two areas by a single rail line.
The rail cannot be crossed easily—it only opens at special moments.
Miss that chance, and you may be trapped here forever.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Survival Rules of the Ghost Station[/b][/h2][p][b]
Tickets[/b]
· Old, worn tickets are scattered around the station.
· But are they just scraps of paper… or the key to survival?[/p][p][b]The Train’s Arrival[/b] 
· Sounds and flashes of light will guide you.
· Fail to seize the moment, and it may never return.[/p][p][b]Secrets of the Safe[/b]
· Inside the train lies a mysterious safe.
· Unlocking it may open a fleeting path to escape.
· But true freedom? That remains uncertain.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Creatures[/b][/h2][p][b]
Common Creature: Door of Death – Ostiumortis[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/2f6d52fa39b0bff1f8f5b224e606349b27ff68cf.png"][/img]A door at the end of the corridor…[/p][p]Will it lead to freedom, or straight into death?[/p][p]The answer reveals itself the moment you turn the handle.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Boss: The Perpetual Attendant, John[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/fc979b8c614433391f1b4dbd6bf991c3d7e51cd3.png"][/img]A station attendant cursed to wander the final stop, never letting a passenger escape.[/p][p]If he seizes you, you may never break free on your own.[/p][p]But with your allies… hope remains.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]UI Updates[/b][/h2][p]The UI of [i]Spectral Scream[/i] has been further refined.[/p][p]This overhaul isn’t just about convenience—it’s designed to help players grasp the game more intuitively.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Help Menu Improvements[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Before[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/dd26f03f8620873ea5b4c73d1f94b92c1821bbfe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]After[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/794fb5cef5cffee3b7f43f7d1ba6d16561f80d8c.png"][/img]· All essential information can now be accessed in one place.
· HP is displayed as a gauge instead of %, making it easier to read at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/929c0d129d176c8bb4f1dfcbf7ddd220f25c7598.png"][/img]· Toggle show/hide functions keep the screen clean when needed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shop UI Overhaul[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Before[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/d643dae7d6b425924b7cf47416ca21ad5be8719a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]After[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892400/820c2ea59722db8676bc71461312efd74891c7f2.png"][/img]· Item prices are now clearly displayed.
· All items fit neatly on a single page, no scrolling required.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2][p]· Minor bug fixes[/p][p]· General game stabilization[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Future Plans[/b][/h2][p]· Each stage will be given stronger conceptual identity for richer gameplay.[/p][p]· Co-op mechanics and horror elements will be further enhanced.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Feedback & Community[/b][/h2][p]· Share your thoughts on our [b]official Discord[/b] and [b]Steam Community Hub.[/b][/p][p]· Feedback on [b]map gimmick difficulty[/b] and [b]boss fight balance[/b] will be especially important for the next patch.[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t miss the train.
At least… not in this lifetime.[/p][p][b]Your ever-kind Guide from Purgatory.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Halloween DLC Sales Suspension and Event Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Spectral Scream development team. 
We have received many concerns from our users regarding the Halloween DLC released today. 
We would like to provide you with an update on the situation.

Initially, we planned to release both the Halloween event and DLC simultaneously on Friday, October 25th. 
Our design intention was to allow players with sufficient time to earn items through gameplay, while offering the DLC as an alternative option for those with limited time. 
However, due to our lack of experience with Steam releases, we failed to properly estimate the DLC review period. 
As a result, while the Halloween event began on Friday, October 25th, the Halloween DLC launched on Wednesday, October 30th.

After careful consideration of user feedback, we have made the following decisions:

[b]DLC Sales Suspension and Refund[/b]
- We are immediately discontinuing sales of the Halloween event DLC
- All users who have purchased the DLC will receive a full refund (to be processed automatically through Steam)

[b]Halloween Event Improvements[/b]
- Event rewards will now be obtainable exclusively through gameplay, as originally intended
- We will increase the Halloween coin acquisition rate to ensure rewards can be collected within reasonable playtime
- Detailed information about event improvements will be announced in a separate notice

Moving forward, we will prioritize our users' valuable time and effort in planning and operating events. 
We sincerely apologize for compromising the gameplay experience and game integrity.

Thank you for your warm support and constructive feedback. 
We will strive to improve and deliver a better gaming experience.

Sincerely,
Spectral Scream Dev Team

notes.title: 1.0.11 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, This is Spectral Scream.

We are continuously striving to improve the gaming experience based on your valuable feedback. The core of this update is to ensure that all players can enjoy optimal challenges suited to their skills and experience.

Many of you expressed difficulties with the initial difficulty level, so our development team has been working tirelessly to prepare three difficulty settings. Please check the details below.

[Addition of Difficulty Settings]

Easy Mode: Suitable for beginners, ideal for learning the game.
Normal Mode: A balanced difficulty for players who have a good understanding of the game.
Hard Mode: A high-difficulty setting for skilled players, corresponding to the original difficulty.

Each difficulty level is designed to allow you to immerse yourself more easily in Spectral Scream's fascinating purgatory world and enjoy challenges that match your skills.

[Major Changes]

Improvement of Item Acquisition and Sales

- Adjustments made to dropped items and shop items for each chapter.
- New items can be acquired and purchased progressively from Chapter 1 to Chapter 3.
- The EMF distribution location has been changed from the outdoor table to the entrance of Chapter 1.

Adjustment of Creature Appearance Patterns (Based on Hard Mode)

- Hoarders and Brothers have been removed from Chapter 1. As a result, demon-type creatures no longer appear in Chapter 1.
- Instead, Ghouls and Living Dead now appear in Chapter 1.

[Fixed Issues]

- Fixed an issue where SteamVR was unnecessarily running in Desktop mode
- Fixed an intermittent inventory malfunction caused by trap-type items
- Optimized light-related performance
- Various other bug fixes

We apologize for any inconvenience and kindly ask players to update the again.
*(If the update button is not displayed, please manually update through 'Integrity Check'.)

Visit Spectral Scream Official Discord!
https://discord.gg/5S2udpMM3u

Thank you.

notes.title: 10/4 Update Preview - Bug Fixes and Difficulty Balancing
notes.content:
New Difficulty Selection(Easy, Medium, Hard), Bug fixes

Hello everyone,

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by bugs and balance issues in the game. We are deeply considering the difficulty problems and bugs you have raised since the recent official release. We want to inform you that we are doing our utmost to improve the game based on your valuable feedback.

[b]Bug Fix and Game Improvement Plan
[/b]

notes.title: Spectral Scream v1.0 - Now Officially Released!
notes.content:
Hello, This is Spectral Scream.

The wait is over! [b]Spectral Scream[/b] has officially launched today, [b]August 29th, 2024. [/b]
After months of tireless development and invaluable feedback from our early access community, we're thrilled to present you with the full release of our cooperative horror exploration game.

The following items have been updated in the game.
For more details, Please check below.

[h3][b][New Chapter][/b][/h3]
A completely new Chapter 4 set in a terrifying ghost hotel has been added!
New environments, puzzles, and menacing enemies await you.

[h3][b][New Boss Creatures][/b][/h3]
- Each chapter now features a unique boss with special mechanics:
  - Chapter 1: Maid
  - Chapter 2: Clown
  - Chapter 3: Chloe
  - Chapter 4: Bellboy
- Bosses can't be exorcised through conventional methods but are defeated upon chapter completion.

[h3][b][New Creatures][/b][/h3]
- Scarecrow
- Doppelganger
- Geisha

[h3][b][New Items][/b][/h3]
- Crossbow: Effective against Undead-type creatures from a distance.
- Thread and Bell trap: Subdues nearby Ghost-type creatures.
- Lamb's Blood: Subdues nearby Demon-type creatures.
- Adrenaline: Allows unlimited sprinting for a limited time.
- Hourglass: Temporarily teleports the user outside, then returns them to the original location.
- Teleporter: Forcefully summons all living players to the outside.
- Red Butterfly: Remotely summons a corpse.

[h3][b][Fixed Issues][/b][/h3]

[b]- Gameplay Improvements[/b]
  - Resolved an issue where player corpses were not reviving instantly
  - Fixed a bug where noise-cancelling tinnitus persisted for players in a downed state
  - Addressed an issue where noise dolls were activating despite being blocked by closet doors
  - Corrected a problem where the scarecrow face shader was only visible to the server host
  - Fixed missing alert sounds when team members died or were incapacitated
  - Resolved an issue where players could get trapped in item sale boxes after reviving corpses
  - Corrected bugs related to nearby player health recovery upon creature elimination

[b]- Visual and Audio Enhancements[/b]
  - Improved lighting for merchants and carriages
  - Fixed discrepancies in the number of creatures subdued by players on the results screen
  - Resolved headset recognition issues during gameplay
  - Corrected errors in party member location display

[b]- Multiplayer and Network Improvements[/b]
  - Fixed item stock display errors in shops at game start (multiplayer)
  - Improved VOIP server login stability
  - Addressed low voice volume issues for other players in the lobby
  - Resolved infinite loading when entering password-protected rooms
  - Fixed game-ending condition errors after server host death

[b]- Other Improvements[/b]
  - Addressed intermittent orb collection issues
  - Fixed lobby language change application problems
  - Corrected footstep sound playback errors while in a downed state
  - Fixed ESC menu malfunctions after game exit
  - Resolved player icon display issues for deaths in different chapters
  - Corrected feedback manager malfunction when stamina is depleted
  - Addressed intermittent entrance/exit UI display issues
  - Fixed mouse sensitivity settings application in spectator mode
  - Improved chapter opening time synchronization

Additionally, we've made various performance improvements and stability enhancements. We continue to strive to provide an even more terrifying yet enjoyable experience. We look forward to your valuable feedback, so please share your thoughts as you play the game.

We apologize for any inconvenience and kindly ask players to update the again.
*(If the update button is not displayed, please manually update through 'Integrity Check'.)

[b][Full Release Trailer][/b]
[previewyoutube=s8H7OuVwMww;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you.
